title: Indecisive SMP
description: The OFFICIAL modpack of Indecisive season 4! a mix of performance, cosmetic, and utility
body:
This is the official modpack for the Indecisive SMP.

The modpack's primarily contains lightweight client side mods, mostly for increased performance in multiplayer servers. 

This modpack also features and array of mods to replace statndard optifine features, such as zoomify, connected textures, and lamb's dynamic lights.

The biggest focus of this modpack is simple voice chat. This Provides an in-game proximity chat and enhances the multiplayer aspect of servers without having to use third party apps like discord.

The Modpack also includes some off-by-default mostly cosmetic mods that you can enable to make Minecraft look/play a little better. Examples would be Not enough animations(adds some new player animations) and 3D skin l;ayers(makes the outside of players' skins 3D.

This Modpack was created for users of the Indecisive SMP. It is not required to play on the server, but it is recommended! If you aren’t a member of the server, you can feel free to use it as well, it would hopefully make a good base pack for a client-side Modpack.

Some Default Keybinds:

Push to talk: Caps Lock
Voice Chat Menu: V
Zoom in: C
